summary: Iteration 36 (guest/demo removal, /welcome + first-run tour + Wardrobe empty state) verified end-to-end. Backend: 12/12 tests pass — POST /api/auth/guest is gone (returns 405), brand-new register account returns empty /items, empty /outfits, is non-premium, no plans/wear history, can log out & log in again, and DELETE /api/auth/account cleans it up. Reviewer (review@aureve.app) still logs in, is Premium, and still returns the 16-item demo wardrobe. Frontend: splash correctly lands on /welcome when signed-out, welcome-start-free + welcome-log-in exist, guest-login-button testID nowhere in DOM, onboarding final CTA reads 'Create Free Account' and routes to /login?mode=signup with primary button 'Create account'; registering a brand-new account routes to Home and shows the 5-step app-tour once (5 Next clicks close it; tour flag cleared and does not reappear on subsequent Home visit); Wardrobe empty state shows new copy 'Your wardrobe is ready when you are' + 'Add your clothes to start getting personalised outfits.' with wardrobe-empty-add and wardrobe-empty-bulk buttons and NO demo garments; Profile 'How Aureve Works' (how-aureve-works) replays the tour; Sign-out routes to /login and re-opening / correctly lands on /welcome. Reviewer smoke: reviewer login still succeeds, tour does NOT appear for reviewer, home-plan-week present.

ui_bugs.issue: handleSwitchAccount calls `login()` but `login` is not destructured from useAuth() (only user/logout/deleteAccount are). Tapping the 'Switch account' row (testID switch-account) will throw ReferenceError: login is not defined. Not on the current iteration-36 test surface but a latent regression to fix.

react_native_issues.issue: Runtime warning: 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents'. Reference: /app/frontend/app/onboarding.tsx:106 (pointerEvents={entering ? "auto" : "none"}) — should move to style.pointerEvents on the Animated.View.

action_items: Fix profile.tsx: destructure `login` from useAuth() (or remove the Switch account row since login is Google-only now). Currently ReferenceError on tap.
Move `pointerEvents` from prop to style on the onboarding fade-cover Animated.View to silence the React Native deprecation warning.
critical_code_review_comments: profile.tsx line 65 references `login()` without importing/destructuring — latent runtime bug on Switch account row.

AuthContext still exposes `isGuest`/`is_guest` plumbing (GUEST_MIGRATE_KEY, stashGuestToken, guest_token in register/apple bodies) even though the guest endpoint is gone; safe but dead-code candidate for cleanup in a follow-up.
